key_highlights: ASX 200 falls under pressure led by mining losses, energy sector weakness, and tech sell-offs.
RBA Deputy Governor warns worsening inflation outlook, lifting expectations for a fifth cash rate hike.
Australian flash PMI drops into contraction while AUD faces growth shock pressures.
NextDC shares tumble on Melbourne data centre expansion delays; Westpac initiates workforce reductions.
China trade frictions and Pilbara margin threats cloud outlook for major iron ore producers.

sectors.trend: Heavy selling in bulk iron ore miners due to China trade disputes and long-term supply threats, offset by selective gold and critical minerals exploration.
sectors.implications: Earnings headwinds for major miners (BHP.AX, FMG.AX, RIO.AX); capital rotating toward safe-haven precious metals.

sectors.trend: Margin pressure compounding as Westpac cuts jobs and private credit failures impact property development finance.
sectors.implications: Asset quality risks rising for major banks (WBC.AX, CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX) as property downturn deepens.

sectors.trend: Valuation de-rating following Wall Street tech declines and local operational execution delays.
sectors.implications: NextDC (NXT.AX) delays raise concerns over near-term capex returns and capacity delivery schedules.

sectors.trend: Sharp equity retreat in energy producers alongside massive cost blowouts in national transition projects.
sectors.implications: Snowy 2.0 blowout to $25b highlights escalating project risks, weighing on energy infrastructure sentiment.

sectors.trend: Discretionary retail slump driven by elevated mortgage servicing costs and weak consumer sentiment.
sectors.implications: Nick Scali (NCK.AX) sell-off confirms consumer spending compression, threatening retail sector margins.

sectors.trend: Defensive resilience supported by idiosyncratic clinical trial advancements.
sectors.implications: Biotech developments like Amplia (ATX.AX) provide non-correlated alpha amid macro weakness.

key_themes: Macroeconomic stagflation risks from contracting flash PMI and persistent inflation pressures.
Bulks vulnerability from bilateral trade tensions and emerging global iron ore supply.
Infrastructure and capex cost overruns dampening transition economics.
Credit stress spreading across residential development and non-bank lenders.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-beta consumer discretionary and highly leveraged REITs; preserve cash liquidity.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China Iron Ore Demand and Price Shocks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to pure-play bulk miners; rotate into gold and diversified miners.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Private Credit Contagion and Developer Insolvencies
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid direct commercial property debt and high-risk construction contractors.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Tech Infrastructure Capex Delays and De-rating
risk_assessment.mitigation: Scale back high-multiple growth equities in favor of profitable infrastructure with locked-in cash flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold producers with expanding domestic reserves
opportunities.rationale: Gold serves as a hedge against currency volatility, stagflation risks, and geopolitical instability.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective entry in oversold data centre infrastructure on weakness
opportunities.rationale: NXT.AX sell-off presents longer-term value given structural cloud and sovereign AI capacity demand.
CSL provides robust global revenue streams insulated from domestic macro and consumer downturns.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim exposure to high-cost iron ore producers
defensive_moves.rationale: China trade disputes and emerging Simandou supply threaten Pilbara margins and cash returns.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge ASX 200 exposure and reduce consumer discretionary holdings
defensive_moves.rationale: Flash PMI contraction and further RBA rate hike risks threaten corporate earnings across cyclical sectors.

market_outlook.short_term: 1–3 month outlook is bearish for ^AXJO due to stagflationary pressures, RBA hike odds, and commodity price softening.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook hinges on RBA rate peak, Chinese stimulus efficacy, and corporate cost stabilization.
